name: ROG GT-AXE16000
notes: This support-only entry covers ROG GT-AXE16000 (GT-AXE16000). It summarizes the ASUS stock firmware and AsusWrt-Merlin support listed for this model. No firmware was flashed.

hardware.note: Wi-Fi: Quad-band AXE16000: 2.4 GHz 4x4 up to 1 148 Mbps, 5 GHz-1 and 5 GHz-2 4x4 up to 4 804 Mbps each, 6 GHz 4x4 up to 4 804 Mbps; Ports: 1 × 2.5 GbE WAN, 2 × 10 GbE WAN/LAN, 4 × GbE LAN, 1 × USB 3.2 Gen 1, 1 × USB 2.0; Antennas: 8 external (non-detachable) + 4 internal; Buttons: WPS, LED, Reset, Power Switch; SoC is not named in the product specification.

supportRoutes.name: AsusWrt-Merlin
supportRoutes.description: AsusWrt-Merlin 3006.102.9_0 (2026-09-23) is listed for this model. Check the supported-device list for the model and any hardware-revision distinctions.
requirements: Confirm the exact model and any hardware revision against the linked supported-device list; similar model names can use different firmware.

supportRoutes.name: ASUS stock firmware
supportRoutes.description: ASUS lists 3.0.0.6.102_37548 dated 2026-10-20 for GT-AXE16000 on its model support page.
requirements: Match GT-AXE16000 exactly and check the model support page before downloading.
ASUS demonstrates Firmware Restoration separately as its rescue-mode route.

supportRoutes.name: Firmware Restoration
supportRoutes.description: ASUS documents Firmware Restoration for rescue mode. Its FAQ demonstrates the procedure on an RT-AC68U, so its LED timing is not confirmed for this model.
requirements: Unzip the stock firmware before using the utility; it cannot upload an archive.
Use a wired PC with the documented static IP, enter rescue mode by holding Reset while powering on, then restore the stock image.
